notes: UT Dallas's completeness count from the 2026 edition's program list (catalog.utdallas.edu/2026/undergraduate/programs; the edition home prints '2026-2027 Undergraduate Catalog'), recounted 2026-10-21 under programs/catalog_counts.py: most degrees are printed twice ('Bachelor of Science in X (120 semester credit hours)' and 'X (BS)'), which is one program; credit hours are not part of a name; '(Double Major)' entries combine two majors and are not counted; 'BA in X - Y' and 'BS in X - Y' (a concentration or certification focus) are options of 'Bachelor of Arts in X' / 'Bachelor of Science in X', which the list prints.

Corrected after independent review on #227: the list reader kept one link per page, so where one page is linked as both 'Bachelor of Arts in X' and 'Bachelor of Science in X' (Biology, Chemistry, Economics, International Political Economy, Mathematics, Physics, Education) the BS was dropped and the count read 59/64. Each award is now a listed program (69). UT Dallas records such as 'Biology (BA, BS)' are one record for two degrees on one page; a record verifies one program, so 51 of 69 are credited and UT Dallas is partial, not covered.
Current candidates that re-identify a verified bachelor's record on file are counted, one per program page; this decision promotes nothing.
